children: Injective’s governance proposal for its Veyra mainnet upgrade is drawing overwhelming support.
On November 14, Injective said on its official X account that community support for the Veyra mainnet upgrade was overwhelming, with more than 99% of participating stakers voting in favor.
If the current trend continues, the proposal will likely pass in two days, the project added.

The upgrade is designed to advance institutional-grade asset tokenization and strengthen privacy features. Through the upgrade, Injective plans to bolster blockchain infrastructure for institutional investors.

title: Injective Says 99% of Voting Stakers Back Veyra Mainnet Upgrade
